wire: config value -> ints.parse_ints -> the retry schedule

criteria.text: for a str text, parse_ints(text) returns, in order, int(f) for every comma-separated field f of text with f.strip() != ''; a field with f.strip() == '' is skipped
for a str text, parse_ints raises ValueError if int(f) raises ValueError for any comma-separated field f of text with f.strip() != ''
